title: McDonalds
description: This Mod adds a McDonald's structure and villager type and 6 new food items
body: Welcome to the ultimate fast-food expansion! This mod adds a naturally spawning McDonald's structure to your world, complete with a unique Register job block to turn lazy villagers into chefs. Trade emeralds for 6 iconic food items, including burgers, fries, nuggets, and McFlurries.
